sentences.text:
Author: M. Laxman
Bench: M. Laxman
 The Honourable Sri Justice M. Laxman
 Criminal Petition No.6317 of 2023
Order:

1. This petition is filed under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 (Cr.P.C) seeking anticipatory bail to the petitioner, who is arrayed as sole accused in Crime No.281 of 2022 of Central Crime Station, Hyderabad.
The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 408 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. The sum and substance of case of the prosecution is that the petitioner is working as a Junior Accountant in Lions Club Sadhuram Eye Hospital and there are four (04) clerks who regularly collect the money on daily basis and handovers the same to the petitioner, then the petitioner has to deposit the said amount in the Trust Account on the next day.

3. The grievance of the complainant is that a Forensic Audit has been done on suspicious about the shortfall of the amount and found that from 2019 - 2022 there is a shortfall of Rs.99 Lakhs and odd,
therefore, the present complaint.

4. The contention of learned counsel for the petitioner is that he is not only the person involved in the accounting system and every receipts and deposits of money are placed before the higher officers on daily basis and for every three months, six months and one year regular audits are being conducted and those audits reflects there is no fraud.
The petitioner was framed based on the Forensic Audit and according to the learned counsel, the petitioner - accused is innocent.
5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.
6. A close scrutiny of the complaint shows that there is a shortfall of Rs.99 lakhs and odd for a period of three years.
The petitioner had been only primarily dealing with receipts and deposits of money and he was the custodian of money received from other clerks on daily basis.

There may be other Officers involved in the paper work with regard to the data of receipts and deposits of money,
but ultimately the petitioner - accused is the person who specifically deals with receipts and deposits of money.
7. The claim of the petitioner is that in the previous audits nothing was found and it can be tested during the course of investigation.

1 verify further investigation.

sentences.text: If the fresh material is found and the Forensic Audit report is found to be correct, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to arrest the petitioner - accused.
In the said circumstances, I find no merit to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner - Accused.
8. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is dismissed.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any shall stand closed.
